title: Bodies in Formation
observed_structure: Repeated group movement establishes discipline through rhythm and geometry.
A later deviation in timing, spacing, or posture exposes individual pressure against the formation.
misuse_risks: direct imitation of a specific dance or drill
transferable_structure: Use repeated coordinated physical action to establish group order, then make a measurable deviation reveal individual conflict.
non_transferable_surface: Do not copy Beau Travail choreography, uniforms, locations, music, or shot design.
